count_method: Python standard library: exclude the first title line, whitespace, Unicode Cc and Cf characters; include punctuation. Counted exact text passed to write_bytes, not platform back-office word counts.
scope: Two independent scenes only. No project initialization, database, status/context/commit/export commands, real novel files, repository source, or other candidate directories were read.
workflow_adaptation: The explicit standalone-scene authorization takes precedence over managed-book database steps. Followed writing and semantic review requirements in chapter.md; used Python standard library for deterministic length checks.

workshop.causality: 验出四把松动，明早无法可靠交齐；陈渠同意延收余款、承担替代搬运，并暂缓接桌子订单。资金代价与缩规模意见在同场发生。
workshop.continuity: 全篇保持当晚验货场景；问题椅保留砂纸标记后搬入里间。父亲围裙中的铅笔没有跳换位置。
workshop.user_constraints: 陈渠接手父亲作坊、三十把、明早交货、今晚验货、姐姐管账与规模意见均落实；无事故、羞辱、贵人或神秘来客结尾。
workshop.style_evidence: “别收，明早搬错了。” 姐姐的谨慎落在实务动作；客户需要开业座位，保留协商理由。

quiet.causality: 女儿要留鞋楦，母亲顾虑累赘；一起整理剪刀和零料后，母亲为楦底剪毛毡，实际允许女儿留下。
quiet.continuity: 全篇留在鞋铺收拾过程。自审修正鞋楦位置跳变，明确剪刀交接。
quiet.user_constraints: 保留温和母女关系；没有争吵与新来客；对搬家和继续照顾家人的担心通过工具与裤脚对话含蓄呈现。
quiet.style_evidence: “底下毛糙，别刮坏桌子。” 母亲以使用上的照料表达让步，不补解释性升华。

limitations: Semantic review was performed by the writing agent itself, not an independent blind review.
No managed-book state, continuity database, or external factual research was used or claimed.
Counts and hashes establish mechanical properties only; they do not prove literary quality or originality.
